name: CiteBench
intro: CiteBench是一个用于科学引文文本生成的基准测试，旨在系统地研究从多个来源聚合和综合文本知识。该基准统一了多个不同的数据集，支持在不同的任务设计和领域之间对引文生成模型进行标准化评估。CiteBench的发布为引文生成领域的未来研究提供了新的见解和评估方法。
org: Ubiquitous Knowledge Processing (UKP) Lab, Technical University of Darmstadt
build_method: 整合ABURAED/CHEN/LU/XING, 来源专属转换, 标签化统一输入, 引文锚点规范化
metric: ROUGE-1/2/L, BERTScore, 引用意图与CORWA篇章诊断, 人工可读性与一致性
eval_feature: 四来源统一任务, 多领域引文生成, 域内与跨数据集迁移
build_method_en: ABURAED/CHEN/LU/XING integration, source-specific transforms, tagged unified inputs, and normalized citation anchors
eval_feature_en: Four-source unified task, multi-domain citation generation, in-domain and cross-dataset transfer
intro_en: CiteBench is a benchmark for scientific citation text generation, designed to systematically study the aggregation and synthesis of textual knowledge from multiple sources. It unifies various datasets to enable standardized evaluation of citation generation models across different task designs and domains. The release of CiteBench offers new insights and evaluation methods for future research in citation generation.

drawio_review_note: Reviewed against the peer-reviewed EMNLP 2023 paper 2023.emnlp-main.455 (arXiv:2212.09577v3), §§3.1–5.3 and Appendix A.1, with the official repository pinned at commit e0cc3b8e58964b703d94859fdbe61a598bfb2f7d. Official repository file locators: DATASET.md, src/data_processing/related_work_benchmark_construction.py, and src/rel_work/evaluation.py. The diagram preserves the ABURAED, CHEN-Delve, CHEN-S2ORC, LU, and XING conversions without instance-level filtering; exact <abs>/<ctx_b>/untagged cited abstracts/<ctx_a> order; consistent incrementing anchors and XING #OTHEREFR handling; published split counts; LEAD/TextRank/LexRank/LED baselines; HuggingFace ROUGE without stemming plus BERTScore; led-base-[X] transfer; ACL-ARC/CORWA KL diagnostics; and the independent 3-annotator, 150-output XING + CHEN Delve human study.
